subject.title: Request: Add Discord reaction event support to Hooks system

question: Should OpenClaw add generic observation-only `reaction_added` and `reaction_removed` hooks to the public plugin API now, and should the first implementation be Discord-only or a cross-channel contract?
rationale: Source inspection proves the gap, but the names, payload shape, enrichment behavior, privacy/security filters, and cross-channel scope are public API choices that automation should not freeze without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve Generic Observation Hooks
options.body: Add generic observation-only reaction hooks with a shared payload shape, wire Discord first, and document how other channel plugins should converge.

options.title: Scope To Discord First
options.body: Accept a Discord-only hook now, but require explicit follow-up constraints so its payload and semantics do not become a permanent one-off contract.

options.title: Defer Hook Surface
options.body: Keep reaction automation on routed system events or external workarounds until maintainers sponsor a broader plugin hook design.

recommendation.title: Approve Generic Observation Hooks
recommendation.body: Add generic observation-only reaction hooks with a shared payload shape, wire Discord first, and document how other channel plugins should converge.

likelyOwner.reason: The open choice is the public plugin hook API shape, and current/main history ties vincentkoc to the central hook contract files.
